mapper.select: SELECT INCOME, FIXED_EXP, VARIABLE_EXP, SAVING, RESERVE, GOAL_AMOUNT, CONSENT_YN, TO_CHAR(CONSENT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CONSENT_AT, JOURNEY_STEP, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT FROM FINANCE_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO FINANCE_PROFILE t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.INCOME = #{income}, t.FIXED_EXP = #{fixedExp}, t.VARIABLE_EXP = #{variableExp}, t.SAVING = #{saving}, t.RESERVE = #{reserve}, t.GOAL_AMOUNT = #{goalAmount}, t.CONSENT_YN = #{consentYn}, t.CONSENT_AT = CASE WHEN #{consentYn} = 'Y' THEN NVL(t.CONSENT_AT, SYSDATE) ELSE NULL END, t.JOURNEY_STEP = #{journeyStep}, t.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, INCOME, FIXED_EXP, VARIABLE_EXP, SAVING, RESERVE, GOAL_AMOUNT, CONSENT_YN, CONSENT_AT, JOURNEY_STEP, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{income}, #{fixedExp}, #{variableExp}, #{saving}, #{reserve}, #{goalAmount}, #{consentYn}, CASE WHEN #{consentYn} = 'Y' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, #{journeyStep}, SYSDATE)
UPDATE FINANCE_PROFILE SET JOURNEY_STEP = #{journeyStep}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT TIER, SAFETY_K, FALLBACK_YN, TO_CHAR(SCORED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SCORED_AT FROM RISK_SCORE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY SCORED_AT DESC, RISK_SCORE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RISK_SCORE (RISK_SCORE_ID, MEMBER_ID, PROB, TIER, SAFETY_K, FALLBACK_YN, SCORED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_RISK_SCORE.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{prob}, #{tier}, #{safetyK}, #{fallbackYn}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO RISK_SCORE (RISK_SCORE_ID, MEMBER_ID, PROB, TIER, SAFETY_K, FALLBACK_YN, SCORED_AT) SELECT SEQ_RISK_SCORE.NEXTVAL, MEMBER_ID, PROB, TIER, SAFETY_K, 'Y', SYSDATE FROM RISK_SCORE WHERE RISK_SCORE_ID = ( SELECT MAX(RISK_SCORE_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY SCORED_AT, RISK_SCORE_ID) FROM RISK_SCORE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} )
